Through our association with KBibb, LLC, we address our clients’ needs concerning their investments and assets in the United States, as well as obligations arising from U.S. citizenship or tax residency. KBibb is a boutique firm with over 30 years of experience and specialization in international tax consulting, planning, and IRS compliance, representing a wide range of nonresident clients. Their services include:
• Strategic planning and structuring of investments or assets located in the United States, as well as U.S. residents’ investments and assets held abroad.
• Preparation and filing of annual tax returns for individuals and legal entities.
• Obtaining Tax Identification Numbers (TIN) and Employer Identification Numbers (EIN).
• U.S. reporting of bank accounts and foreign investments.
• Calculation of federal and state tax liabilities in the United States.
